summary: Iteration 61 — Book Publishing (Store + KDP), Audiobook (background), Cover Studio publish/kdp/audiobook UI, and honest Storyboard video-status. Backend 12/12 pass. Full end-to-end UI flow verified: attach APPROVED cover to a Book product → deliverable re-rendered → three new actions appear (Add to QRU Store, KDP-Ready Export, Create Audiobook with voice select). Store publish returns 'purchasable' toast, KDP builds real zip w/ interior.pdf + KDP-Publishing-Kit.pdf + cover.png (when cover attached), audiobook creates real 9MB / 35MB MP3 (audio/mpeg) from book content. Storyboard Studio now shows an honest per-video-format render-status note (data-testid=storyboard-video-status-youtube_video) with 'not yet a video' language — the misleading 'ready to publish to YouTube' implication is gone. No fake Amazon 'published' state anywhere.

integration_issues.flow: Cover Studio → Create Audiobook polling (long books)
integration_issues.issue: For large books (~35MB MP3, ~30 min narration) the background job takes ~6-10 minutes and the UI-side setInterval poll receives multiple ingress 502s while the backend is still working. The frontend's silent catch(_) means it keeps polling and eventually surfaces the READY link — but a founder watching the UI has no visual reassurance beyond 'Narrating audiobook in the background…' and no elapsed timer or cancel affordance. Recommend adding an elapsed-time counter or ETA to the rendering pill.

design_issues.screen: Cover Studio product picker inside 'Attach to Product'
issues: Duplicate product titles are indistinguishable ('The Science of — Book' appears twice, 'Forex KR — Book' appears three times). Add product_code or created_at (a short suffix) so the founder can pick the right one deterministically.

Emergent editor injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> — triggers a React hydration console warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Pre-existing (iteration_58-60). Cosmetic/console-only; functionality unaffected. Playwright's native select_option cannot match; had to use the DOM value setter + change dispatch.

critical_code_review_comments: CoverStudio.js:88-101 (makeAudiobook): setInterval poll has NO client-side deadline; if the ingress or job hangs indefinitely the UI stays in 'Narrating…' forever with no timeout. Add a max-wait (e.g., 8 minutes) then surface an honest error toast + clear the pubBusy lock.

product_publishing.py:213 (_audiobook_job): a hard crash of _audiobook_job (e.g., DB unavailable at the very start) never sets FAILED status — the try/except only wraps the TTS call, not the initial db.products.find_one. Wrap the entire function in try/except to guarantee READY|FAILED terminal state.

product_publishing.py:157-162 (kdp_package): the ZIP is regenerated on every POST /kdp-package call — for large books this is wasteful. Consider caching by (product_id, deliverable_hash) or returning the existing zip if source unchanged.

product_publishing.py:26 VOICES excludes 'echo' from the UI dropdown (['onyx','sage','nova','shimmer','fable']) while the backend also accepts 'alloy' and 'echo'. Either narrow the backend or expose the missing voices in CoverStudio.js line 253.

publishing.py:277 (make_audiobook): AudiobookInput has a mutable default `AudiobookInput()` in function signature — FastAPI handles this OK but it's a Python anti-pattern; prefer `data: AudiobookInput | None = None` and default inside the function.

CoverStudio.js is 293 lines with dense inline JSX — consider extracting the per-cover 'Publish actions' subtree into a <CoverPublishActions cover={c} attachResult={ar} …/> component for readability and testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Cover Studio publish + KDP + audiobook UI flow AND Storyboard honest video status verified end-to-end)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints under /api/publishing: /product/{pid}/publish-store, /kdp-package, /kdp-file, /audiobook (accepts {voice}), /audiobook-status, /audiobook-file. Audiobook is BACKGROUND — first POST returns {status: RENDERING} and the client MUST poll audiobook-status; the ingress hard-caps requests at 60s so synchronous TTS is impossible. Frontend: Cover Studio publish/kdp/audiobook buttons only appear AFTER a successful 'Attach & Render' (attachResult[cid] is set); the buttons are keyed by cover-id, not product-id. Playwright's page.select_option() FAILS on any native <select> in this app because the emergent editor injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside every <option>; use the native HTMLSelectElement setter + dispatchEvent('change') pattern instead (see test script comments). Storyboard Studio: the honest render-status note (data-testid=storyboard-video-status-<format>) is only rendered for products whose recipe.render === 'video' — for audio_lesson products no note is shown (correct — they use Render MP3 button flow).
